automatable_note: The ESC button must be pressed after the entry wait. The bench has no actuator for it.

manual.action: Press the button after the tone sequence: 2 s for modes 1 to 3, 5 s for modes 4 to 6.

entry.confirm_signal: Ascending tone sequence after the wait; descending sequence after the button press.
steps: Connect the motor if tones are to be audible. Transmitter on. Throttle to brake for mode 1; to neutral for modes 2 to 6.
Apply drive power. The ESC sounds 3 tones for NiCd/NiMH or 6 tones for LiPo detection.
Wait 2 s (modes 1, 2, 3) or 5 s (modes 4, 5, 6) or until the ESC sounds an ascending tone sequence.
The ESC sounds a descending tone sequence, then the mode series.
Move the throttle to full (stick forward) when the wanted mode sounds.
The ESC confirms with a descending tone sequence. Mode 2: a separate brake position can then be set (optional). Mode 6: move the stick to the brake position afterwards.
Control output: the mode is repeated as tones. Disconnect power.

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to full when the wanted mode sounds.

scheme.confirm_signal: Descending tone sequence, then the mode as tones.
scheme.exit: Disconnect power after the control output.
scheme.description: Brushed ESC with mode programming through the ESC button. The entry wait is 2 s for modes 1 to 3 and 5 s for modes 4 to 6. The series counts modes as tones; full throttle stores the selected mode.

values.name: APM: reset, EMK brake and undervoltage cutoff on, stick range learned at every power-up
Glider: brake and undervoltage cutoff on, optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane / boat: brake off, undervoltage reduction instead of cutoff
Helicopter: throttle compensation for falling battery voltage, linear throttle curve
Competition: maximum brake response, undervoltage and overtemperature cutoff off
Car: proportional brake, undervoltage cutoff off
LiPo undervoltage detection (2.7 to 3 V per cell instead of 0.7 to 0.8 V)

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
The manual's drawings for modes 4 and 5 show '5 sec' between the first and second tone series; whether it is the pause between series is not stated in text.
Entry wait is 2 s in modes 1 to 3 and 5 s in modes 4 to 6; whether the 5 s is a minimum or the same as the 'until the ESC signals' condition is not stated.
Position of the button on the ESC is not stated.
notes: INDEX.csv lists 'ProgCard'; the manual names the ProgCARD (order no. 9305) for individual parameters.
The motor drive is brushed ('Kollektormotoren'), 3-wire inputs only.

Modes 2, 3, 5, 6 and 9 start at 'Neutralstellung', which the manual does not place (Kontronik_Sun_Plus.pdf p.4-7); mode 6 has a separate brake step after it. They carry entry_throttle mid, so stick programming does not store them from the brake position. Mode 4's English text gives 'neutral position (back position)'.

Modes 4, 5 and 6 wait 5 s for the ascending tones before the button (Kontronik_Sun_Plus.pdf p.5-6 DE, p.12-13 EN), modes 1, 2, 3 and 9 wait 2 s: entry_hold_ms 5000 on modes 4 to 6, the scheme's 2000 ms for the rest.
Mode 6 moves the stick to the brake position after the full-throttle selection (Kontronik_Sun_Plus.pdf p.6-7 DE, p.13 EN): after_select min, made STORE after the selection; the manual gives no time.
